notes.title: Bug Fix #2
notes.content:
Hello!

Here are some additional fixes to make the game a little more enjoyable:
- The level selection menu is much more stable than before, and should no longer lag as you navigate from world to world.
- Lasers that appear and disappear in rhythm are now harmless when passed through while they are blinking (on or off). So there is more time to cross them.
- Some other minor bugfixes

Thank you and have fun =]

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello!
I've just fixed a few bugs:
- You can no longer go through lianas without opening them in world 5
- You can now safely go back to level selection after being killed, without corrupting the save
- Other minor sound fixes

notes.content: Play the Larcin Lazer demo now! Observe your surroundings and remember the location of the lasers, they disappear as soon as you move. Move with style to dodge the many obstacles spread across more than 100 levels. Prepare for a MEMORABLE heist
